name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity for keyboard navigation. This ensures high contrast against any background while keeping the focus indicator visible and unobtrusive. The trade-off is slightly reduced focus ring visibility on very light backgrounds, but the white stroke mitigates this risk. This choice balances accessibility needs with visual clarity for all users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring with white stroke fails on dark mode: WCAG 2.2 AA requires 3:1 contrast for focus indicators, and the white stroke at 50% opacity drops below that on dark backgrounds. A better alternative is a 3px solid #ffffff focus ring with a 1px solid #005fcc outer stroke—guaranteed contrast on both light and dark modes. Test with a screen reader and forced-colors mode to confirm.
